items.title: 19.4 Aliphatic organic compounds ke naam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nomenclature of aliphatic compounds (PDF 41-44).

blocks.text: Qudrat mein karoron organic compounds hain aur har saal hazaron naye banaye jate hain, is liye IUPAC (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry) ne un ki banawat se baqaida naam rakhne ke usool banaye. Systematic naam parent hydrocarbon par mabni hota hai aur is ke yeh hisse hain:

items: Stem ya root: sab se lambi musalsal carbon zanjeer jis mein functional group wala carbon shamil ho; us carbon ko sab se kam mumkin number milta hai. Halqe ke liye cyclo lagta hai.
Primary suffix (stem ka suffix): batata hai ke zanjeer saturated hai ya unsaturated: -an-, -en- ya -yn-.
Secondary suffix (functional group ka suffix): khandani naam deta hai, maslan -ol, -al, -one.
Prefix: kisi shaakh (alkyl group) ya substituent, jaise halo ya nitro, ka naam aur jagah, us carbon ke number ke saath jis se jura ho. Prefix na ho to naam sirf stem aur suffixes hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar rangeen dabbe systematic naam ke hisse batate hain: prefix, stem, primary suffix aur secondary suffix. Do hal shuda misalein: Cl-CH2-CH2-CH2-CHO, CHO carbon se number, 4-chloro + but + an + al = 4-chlorobutanal; CH3-C(CH3)=CH-CH2-OH, CH2OH sire se number, 3-methyl + but + 2-en + 1-ol = 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol.
blocks.caption: Systematic naam ke hisse, do hal shuda misalon ke saath (kitab ke khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Systematic naam ko baen se daen prefix, stem, primary suffix aur secondary suffix parhein. Pehli misal mein zanjeer ke chaar carbon (but), sirf single bonds (an) aur aldehyde group (al) hain, aur carbon 4 par chlorine. Doosri mein chaar carbon ki zanjeer mein carbon 2 se double bond (2-en), carbon 1 par OH group (1-ol) aur carbon 3 par methyl group hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki pehli misal mein ghalati
blocks.text: Kitab Cl-CH2-CH2-CH2-CHO ki zanjeer ko 1 se 4 tak number karti lekin naam '4-chloro prop an al' likhti hai. Chaar carbon ki zanjeer ka stem but- hai, is liye naam 4-chlorobutanal hai.

blocks.explanation: CH3CH2CH(CH3)CHO; HCOOCH(CH3)2; C6H5CH2COOH; chhe carbon ka halqa jis mein aik C=O, C6H10O; CH3CH2CH(CH3)CH2CHO.

items: Naam = prefix + stem + primary suffix + secondary suffix.
Sab se lambi zanjeer functional group ke qareeb sire se number karein.
